text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The ruling Socialist Party (PS) and opposition centre-right Social Democratic Party (PSD) agreed to sign an agreement to revise the constitution next Sunday.
- Chinese President Jiang Zemin agreed yesterday that a Portuguese school can be established in Macau when Portugal hands over the territory to China in 1999.

- The Portuguese state is losing more than 1.5 billion escudos a year in tax revenues in the construction, public works and timber industries because the sectors employ some 100,000 unregistered workers who pay no taxes, trade union figures show.
- Senior German business officials believe that Portugal is the best-placed country among southern European states to join Economic and Monetary Union from the start, according to an opinion poll.
- Solidarity and Social Security Minister Eduardo Ferro Rodrigues, in an interview with the paper, rejects criticism about delays in social security reforms.
